description: The industry's key: short, lower-case and never reused. Spots, waybills and the site's industries.json name an industry by it (ADR-039). Interchange is a kind of traffic, not an industry, so it has no row (owner, 2026-11-25).

The industry's name as Operations Pro spells it (owner, 2026-11-25). The name columns of spot_assignments.csv and HART_Spot_Waybills.csv still print A Stucki Co and Ferrel Gas, because the STS seed in external/sts-helpers has those spellings in its code; one later follow-up renames them together. Until then www/scripts/tests/test_industry_ids.py maps them through its alias list.
The name the website shows (the name of its entry in www/data/industries.json).
The anchor of the industry's spot sheet on the site (crew/industries/#slug, the spot of its entry in www/data/industries.json, an id in crew.json spotsheet).

The short public description: the blurb of its entry in www/data/industries.json (the site search shows it) copies it. Every row has a public page, so it is required on every row. Filled from industries.json on 2026-11-25; lane L5 settles the text.
